answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring collateral, ensuring that influence flows like a controlled river rather than a chaotic echo of infinite fake identities. Without the fable of costless participation, an attacker must acquire significant capital to gain network authority. The prohibitive cost of acquiring enough assets to influence consensus renders the deployment of multiple malicious agents economically irrational and fundamentally unsustainable.
